scripts.db:push: mkdir -p prisma && touch prisma/dev.db && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./prisma/dev.db} prisma db push
scripts.db:push:test: mkdir -p prisma && touch prisma/test.db && DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db prisma db push
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push:test && vitest run
